source_contracts: TDqOutput is the actual callable name, and Stage/Index are children 0/1; including the AST head gives positions 1/2, as used by the probe.

DqPhyStage Inputs/Program are children 0/1, and the probe checks program-argument count against input count. The production builder constructs connections and matching program arguments in stage order.
MapJoinCore, GraceJoinCore and BlockHashJoinCore all have left/right inputs at children 0/1 and JoinKind at child 2; probe AST positions 1/2/3 are correct.

BuildSwitch orders outputs by GetReplicateOutputIndex. Every branch selector reads input index 0 and each branch is an OrderedMap with direct Member renames; the probe checks the same alternating selector/lambda layout.

The accepted terminal hub must be one resolved stage node, with different valid ports reached from the Inner and outer Left left-input paths. The branch source-field sets must be identical and each branch projection must have unique output/source names.
The outer Left right-input path must contain the Inner join stage. An arbitrary Switch elsewhere in a UNION producer does not satisfy these relationships.
The dependency walk stops when a stage depends on multiple stage inputs. This prevents ordinary multi-input UNION reconvergence from being treated as one unary source path.
Observed topology can be true while all exact shared-value and complete-admission flags remain false; the code never promotes those flags.
missing_proof: Dependencies are stage-input sets, not field-specific value lineage. They do not map reconstruction key columns to each terminal-port Member output.

The checker does not follow key-column positions through Map/ExpandMap/StablePickle, prove that both compared identities refer to the same already-evaluated field, or bind that field to the selected aggregate output.

It does not trace UNION arm projections, MIN/CAST results, or SUM finish/state lambdas. Independent downstream aggregate recomputation can therefore share the same earlier stage topology without satisfying value identity.

exact_shared_producer_origin_proved, aggregation_value_to_identity_binding_proved and full_shared_producer_contract_pass must remain false until a separately reviewed field-lineage proof is bound to the same revision/generator/physical-AST hash.
conservative_shape_limits: All hub branches must expose identical nonempty source-field sets. Legitimate liveness-pruned projections with unequal sets are rejected.
The checker expects exactly two recognized joins and inter-stage paths. Fused-stage reconstruction, other physical join forms, or additional joins may be unsupported.
Generic lambda dependencies are conservative sets; parameter-sensitive dataflow is not reconstructed.
An unrelated malformed or non-projection terminal Switch can reject the whole graph. Such rejection is no correctness verdict on the production fix.
No native AST or generated workload was parsed or rendered during this source review. Actual bounded observation is still pending.
